independent_profile_comparison.limitation: Numeric control/timing differences do not prove perceptual distinction. The 36-profile baseline is intentionally separate from the newer integration checkpoints.

static_native_receipt.scope: Eight Triumphant Grin anchors with bilateral low inward-angled brows, equal ordinary focused lids and a centered tooth-bearing then more open smile. Existing tooth support is coupled to smile/spread; no independent dental control, clench or new anatomy. State and geometry do not establish native visual fidelity, normal-speed observation or approval.

mp4_order_checks.method: All decoded frames compared with same-index full/detail native panels and all-frame nearest-face errors; identical and near-identical holds remain ambiguous under lossy encoding.
